verdict.rationale: Apple's only relevant claim is a marketing line that M4 Max handles demanding pro workloads with Apple silicon energy efficiency and long laptop battery life, plus claims of real-time DaVinci Resolve de-noising and dual ProRes engines for video work. Nothing in the pack documents wattage envelopes or tests sustained, throttle-free rendering; the community Geekbench comparison measures short bursts, not long exports. Missing for 10: documented power envelopes or TDP figures, independent sustained-load or long-render throttling tests, measured performance-per-watt data.
